notes:
Uploading a mission now asks what to label the flight: the mission's
own name, or the current time as yymmddhhmm. Choosing the time creates
a new mission named by the time from the plan you are uploading, and
every leg of that flight files under it in the mission list, leaving
the original plan untouched. Rerunning a flown leg is not asked and
goes out under its own name as before.
